CustomField.label: Record Page Field
CustomField.description: On a record page, the grid shows only the records whose field of this name points to the page's record, such as AccountId for a Contacts grid on Account pages. It must be a lookup of the grid's object. Leave blank to show the same records on every page; on App and Home pages it has no effect.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: On a record page, show only records whose lookup of this name points to the page's record. Example: AccountId.
